newsitem.title: CANADA: Tee-Comm, Citizens units in deal.
newsitem.headline: Tee-Comm, Citizens units in deal.

text.p: Tee-Comm Electronics Inc unit AlphaStar Television Network Inc and Citizens Utilities Co subsidiary Citizens Telecom said on Tuesday they signed a satellite television distribution deal.
Under the agreement, Citizens Telecom will offer AlphaStar's digital direct-to-home satellite television service to its subscribers in 22 states.
Citizens Telecom can also offer the service through all subsidiaries and affiliates of its parent, Citizens Utilities, companies said.

"We are confident our customers will be delighted with the AlphaStar offering, and, within six months, we will be able to send them a single bill for that and all their telecommunications services," David Bello, vice-president of strategy and business development at Citizens Telecom said in a statement.
Stamford, Connecticut-based AlphaStar is America's first MPEG-2/DVB world standard direct-to-home (DTH) satellite television provider to serve all 50 states, Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands.
